rungs_done.title: carried dependency chain (prefix sum)
rungs_done.demands: a dependent chain and nothing else. No contraction, no gather, no early exit to confound it.
rungs_done.distinguishing_evidence: notes/26 §5c claims the framework cannot keep a dependent chain in registers, has no loop, and that UNROLL is capped at 32 (notes/06 C-16). A scan is the clean test because the chain IS the operator. The falsifier for class (i)/(iii) is the framework's own `cumsum` op: it exists, so 'the framework cannot express a scan' is false by inspection, and the live question becomes whether its lowering emits N dependent kernels or one. That is countable on the device, and notes/06 C-22 is the correction that says a CENSUS is not a measurement -- so the count is reported as context and the TIME is the evidence.
rungs_done.seed_note: fixed seeds in axis/rungs.py; both arms read the same buffers
rungs_done.tg_note: end-to-end: Python graph build + realize + sync. NOT the ratio's numerator -- see tg_device.
